body:
One of the best movie I've ever watched. The movie is about a COP catching a killer. It's really a exciting movie and the story is interesting because we don't know what's going to happen.

The film masterfully crafts an atmosphere of suspense allowing the tension to build and the performance is gripping.

The cenematography , VFX, editing and the acting is stunning.

* Intense investigation of a serial killer.

* Suspenseful plot with unexpected twists.

* Great performances from the cast.

* Keeps you guessing until the end.

* Excellent cinematography.

Actor Sagar(Rk naidu/munna bhai) did a great acting.

All the best to cast & crew.

Good screenplay and taking and very good camara work.. music also very much support. Super.. good attempt to police story. Nice.. nice.. nice. Vishnu Priya and villain very good performance.. sagar (r k naidu). As usual great gob. Good production values. Mainly last one is heroine very cute and beautiful.

An exciting and engaging film, this movie is a refreshing break from the stream of overhyped releases we've seen recently. It's not just entertaining-it carries a meaningful emotions backed by a well-written script.

What truly sets this film apart is its powerful dialogues. Dialogues like "thappu ane padaniki definition manishi manishiki maaripothune vuntundhi" & "manaiddarm thappu cheyaledhu, kani thappu jarindhi, siksha manakendhuku" adds emotional weight to key moments, spark thought-provoking conversations, and even provide bursts of humor at just the right times.

With strong storytelling, sharp writing, and especially standout dialogue, this movie is definitely worth a watch.

Heartfelt congratulations

100" is a gripping and powerful film that blends action, emotion, and social relevance with finesse. The screenplay and direction both are so tight and engaging, keeping the audience hooked throughout. The director deserves special appreciation for delivering a strong message in such an impactful and entertaining way. The background score and storytelling elevate the movie to a whole new level. A must-watch for lovers of meaningful cinema.

It's never easy to convey a socially relevant message while keeping the audience engaged but as a director, you've handled it exceptionally well ( Raghav Omkar Sasidhar ).. Educating the audience while entertaining them is a rare skill, and you've achieved it with excellence.
